reuse: AuditProblem objective_gradient/metrics/classify, projected_kkt, full_hessian and hessian_audit imported unchanged; hessian output routed to new directory only
refinement_method: interval bisection; no brentq unless all smoothness conditions proved; this implementation always retains interval
jacobian: chain rule of projected residual using unchanged full_hessian, central/one-sided epsilon=3e-6; derivative probes are algebraic only
domain_policy: Stop on any least_squares trial outside original pure-tension/sc domain; Hessian derivative probes use algebraic extension and are never branch states
critical_cone_authorization: User explicitly selected critical-cone classification; keep all auxiliary one-sided probes. Strong-bound opening directions with positive first-order energy are not instability evidence.
weak_bound_rule: Strong lower components fixed to zero in critical cone; weak lower components nonnegative; interior free; one-sided cone negative direction can prove instability, positive random probes cannot certify weak-bound stability
landscape_policy: Save every requested probe and rejection; do not plot invalid phase/domain points as valid energies. If critical mode is one-sided, retain one-sided curve and separately use nearest interior unstable state for the requested symmetric check.
scope: Diagnostic same-branch fixed schedules and bracket refinement only; no solver replacement or branch switching; no extrapolation beyond requested .013 endpoint
matrix_free_scheme: central if phase bounds allow; split active-bound components and use legal second-order one-sided derivatives; algebraic mechanical probes are not physical branch states
stationary_jacobian_step_rationale: Phase-only energy gradient is at most quadratic; second-order one-sided derivative has no truncation error. Larger exact-polynomial step avoids cancellation after residual row scaling. HVP scientific audit retains three original epsilons. Each split vector is separately normalized.
